text:
maria: Thinking about per-org rate policy UI — do we show RPM/TPM and concurrency separately, or try to surface an "effective allowed" metric that includes burst credits?
kevin: I'd prefer effective + knobs. most users don't grok TPM vs RPM. show: sustained rate, burst capacity, concurrency cap. simple graph + tooltip.
ash: routing note: enforcement differs if we do it at edge vs backend. edge-level token-bucket for RPM/TPM + router-level semaphore for concurrency avoids overload loops.
maria: good point. how do we communicate burst semantics? e.g., 1min burst window vs ephemeral credits.
kevin: show a 60s rolling burst meter and a small timeline showing credit burn/regen. UI: "Burst window: 60s (credits regenerate at X/min)" also provide "expected tail latency" estimate when burst used.
sophie: telemetry needs: per-org time-series for sustained tokens, burst credit level, active concurrency. plus alerts when burst > 80% for 5m. also surface percent of requests dropped vs queued.
ash: enforcement detail — token-bucket defined on requests, but note we have mixed workloads (embeds vs chat). prefer RPM/TPM as separate buckets and a shared concurrency cap.
maria: can we express policy in a compact JSON for API use? example snippet:
```
{
  "rpm": 1200,
  "tpm": 30000,
  "burst_window_seconds": 60,
  "burst_capacity": 3000,
  "concurrency": 40
}
```
kevin: yes, and expose read-only "effective_rate" computed = rpm + burst_capacity / burst_window_seconds for UI. plus show current credit balance.
sophie: for rollouts: default to conservative caps on new orgs, allow support to request increases. ramp via canary: 1% orgs -> 10% -> 100% and monitor tail p95 latency + token rejection rate.
maria: UX question — where to surface per-org quota usage? console home, per-api key page, and route-level dashboards. quick action: "request more" or "create override" with audit trail.
ash: ops concern: router should log reject reason: "exceeded_rpm" vs "exceeded_concurrency" so we can split alerts. also ensure logs include org_id, key_id, current_tokens.
sophie: suggest a heatmap widget: x-axis time, y-axis orgs sorted by spend, color = burst usage%. lets QA synth traffic to validate alerts.
deploy-bot: policy-service: deploying new ratecalc endpoint /v1/orgs/{id}/effective_rate
kevin: last bit — in docs, call out differences: RPM ~ requests, TPM ~ tokenized units (tokens), concurrency ~ simultaneous active sessions. add examples for chat vs embeddings.
maria: plan: mockup UI + telemetry dashboard this week, implement router metrics and log keys next sprint. assigning follow-ups in tracker. :thumbsup:
